answer_1.quote: Task 4: Causal Gist Generation. This generation task requires models to produce concise and coherent summaries of the underlying causal relationship. ... We evaluate models using ROUGE ... and BERTScore.
answer_1.outputs: causal gists (concise summaries of causal relationships)

answer_2.quote: We adopt the ROUGE suite (ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L) , which measures n-gram overlap between model outputs and references. To assess semantic fidelity, we additionally report BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: All model-generated annotations were subsequently reviewed and refined by the same team of six expert annotators. The full set of 8,800 posts was evaluated by human annotators according to the following dimensions: Causality Accuracy, Causality Type Accuracy, Relevance (Span Extraction), Conciseness (Gist Generation).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each annotation on dimensions such as Causality Accuracy, Causality Type Accuracy, Relevance, and Conciseness using Likert scales.
